text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-Lebanon and Syria signed three economic deals during the extraordinary meeting of the High Lebanese-Syrian Coordinating Committee held in Damascus over the weekend. -Prime Minister Hariri said: "there will be no war and we will not give Israel the pretext to launch it".
-Christian Maronite Patriarch Sfeir said: "What kind of freedom will the journalists have when a censor dictates to them what must be said".
-The Constitutional Council will rule after 20 days in half of the appeals lodged by defeated candidates in the parliamentary elections last September.
-The Lebanese-Syrian Higher Council to meet early next week.
-Minister of Administrative Reform Merhej said: "There is no political atmosphere in the country for administrative reform".
-The Israeli-backed South Lebanon Army militia freed eight prisoners on Sunday from its Khiam jail inside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
